episodes.title: Part I: Marxist Cult Survivor Katy Morgan-Davies Shares Her Harrowing Life Experience And How She Healed From It
episodes.description: Ready to begin your journey of healing? It's time to reclaim your life with elite and discreet premium psychotherapy with Dr. Gregory T. Obert; 👉🏼 www.royaloasispi.com ------------------------------------------------------ In this episode of Meditations by Gregory T. Obert, Dr. Obert speaks with Katy Morgan-Davies, author of Caged Bird, on her horrifying childhood. For 30 years, Katy lived her life trapped in a house under the iron fist of her father, Comrade B, in the Workers' Institute of Marxism-Leninism-Mao Zedong Thought in South London. She was told about the horrors of the world and the importance of submitting to her father's authority. Katy was able to find subtle ways to rebel and see glimpses of the outside world (e.g. reading The Lord of The Rings), all of which gave her comfort in the darkness. This episode explores how one woman's quest to escape her captors gave her a second chance at life and her new life purpose to help others overcome their own fears and challenges. ------------------------------------------------------ Dr. Obert has spent thousands of hours honing his calling and has decades of real results from real people. For those wanting more from their mental health providers, Dr. Obert brings the extra amount of knowledge, professionalism, and understanding that others do not.
